# The trained picker weights (PickerWeights.cpp, generated by training/export_model.py) are not part of the public repository: they
# derive partly from commercial sample loops. Without that file the build uses PickerWeightsStub.cpp and AI Assist is unavailable.
# NOTA_NEURAL=OFF forces that even when the weights are present. Use it for anything that is shared or published.
if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/PickerWeights.cpp)
    set(NOTA_NEURAL_DEFAULT ON)
else()
    set(NOTA_NEURAL_DEFAULT OFF)
endif()
option(NOTA_NEURAL "Include the trained neural picker weights" ${NOTA_NEURAL_DEFAULT})

set(NOTA_DSP_SOURCES Engine.cpp NoteTracker.cpp PickerNet.cpp PitchTracker.cpp)
if(NOTA_NEURAL)
    list(APPEND NOTA_DSP_SOURCES PickerWeights.cpp)
else()
    list(APPEND NOTA_DSP_SOURCES PickerWeightsStub.cpp)
endif()

add_library(nota_dsp STATIC ${NOTA_DSP_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(nota_dsp PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_features(nota_dsp PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(nota_dsp PRIVATE nota_warnings)
if(NOT NOTA_NEURAL)
    target_compile_definitions(nota_dsp PUBLIC NOTA_NO_NEURAL=1)
endif()
